name: game-multi-sdk
description: Multiplayer game SDK monorepo with dual transport modes (Server WebSocket & RTC Host)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/core && npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-server && npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-rtc-host && npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/react
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/core && npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-rtc-host && npm test --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-rtc-host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/transport-rtc-host && npm run typecheck --workspace=@game-multi-sdk/react
